canonicalSource: Monad Exchange lifecycle events indexed by Envio
verifier: Perpl dex-sdk at an identical chain, block hash, log cutoff, and timestamp
contextSource: Nansen; optional context cannot alter canonical numbers

accounting.amounts: Finite decimal strings derived from integer native scales
accounting.positionSide: Perpl wire 0=long and 1=short are verified against source payloads and mapped to ledger 1=long and 2=short; other wire values fail closed
accounting.entryPrice: Preserve V2 Q16 residue: long with nonzero residue uses (stored PNS minus one plus residue/65536), short uses (stored PNS plus residue/65536), then apply the native price scale; integer decimal construction rejects inexact representations
accounting.inversion: Verify prior size and collateral; require the resulting side to differ before applying the post-event state
accounting.realizedPnl: Sum of lifecycle delta_pnl_cns; fees and settled funding are reported separately
accounting.unrealizedPnl: Price PnL plus canonically reconstructed unsettled funding; null if any required open-position mark or funding checkpoint is unknown
accounting.freeBalance: Unavailable under risk-hotpath-v2/v3 because subjectless taker balances are excluded
accounting.openInterest: Sum of mark-derived absolute notionals for proven open positions
accounting.tvl: Isolated position collateral only; not total protocol collateral
accounting.volume: Maker fill price times size, counted once
accounting.protocolFees: Insurance plus protocol fees from supported lifecycle transitions
accounting.liquidationPrice: With proven funding F, max(0, entry + sideSign * (maintenance - deposit - F) / size); equity = deposit + price PnL + F and buffer = equity - maintenance. Unknown funding leaves all three null; missing marks leave equity and buffer null
accounting.executableLiquidityRisk: Unavailable until point-in-time order book depth and execution costs are independently captured
accounting.unrealizedPricePnl: Side-adjusted (mark minus effective entry) times size; wallet aggregate is null if any open position lacks an eligible mark
accounting.unrealizedFunding: One ledger applies signed native payment times pre-effective-block size using the scale at publication. Positive payment debits longs and credits shorts. Exact integer decimal construction rejects range or precision loss. Partial decrease/liquidation/deleveraging subtract the actual fundingCNS settlement; increase/inversion/open reset to zero; collateral changes preserve the balance
accounting.maintenanceMargin: Effective entry price times size divided by the registry maintenance inverse; independent of the current mark
accounting.zeroFundingScenario: Conditional equity = deposit + price PnL; buffer = equity - entry-based maintenance; liquidation = max(0, entry + sideSign * (maintenance - deposit) / size). These fields assume zero unsettled funding and are never actual risk facts
accounting.sdkRiskDiagnostics: Verifier only: compare maintenance exactly, price PnL truncated to collateral native units, and liquidation scenarios using SDK reference funding at market price ticks. SDK marks and funding observations never become canonical inputs
accounting.fundingTimeline: Raw signed int48 payments/sums preserve native units, effective block, source ID, overwrite and scaling observations. Published future payments remain pending. Discontinuity and unauthorized replacement fail visibly. This market timeline is separate from each position's checkpoint proof
accounting.fundingCheckpoint: Requires explicit complete market-publication coverage for the position's market. Coverage beginning at Exchange deployment observes every publication, so any covered reset is proven; otherwise a reset must be at or after the first observed effective schedule, which bounds unknown pre-window pending funding under Perpl's single-pending-schedule rule. Earlier resets or absent baselines stay unknown. A later nonzero payment requires a canonical scaling anchor at publication; unknown scale invalidates the amount until another proven reset. Checkpoints retain reset, baseline, payment/scale and settlement event IDs, coverage start and cutoff. Bare replay never infers zero from absent events
accounting.sdkFundedRiskComparison: Verifier only: project price and funding separately to collateral native units before adding total PnL/equity, because the SDK loads deltaPnlCNS and premiumPnlCNS separately. Buffer uses SDK-width canonical entry-based maintenance. Preserve exact canonical values alongside these projections; liquidation is compared at price ticks. Unknown funding scorecards contain zero checks and remain unverified

eligibility.positionReplay: Exact risk-hotpath-v2 or risk-hotpath-v3 provenance and coverage from deployment or account creation; mixed profiles fail
eligibility.cutoff: One immutable event cutoff shared across all selected accounts
eligibility.freshness: Indexer source lag, observation age, and live processed-watermark advancement are checked separately
eligibility.sourceHeightWitness: If the separately polled Envio source height trails committed progress, preserve the original cutoff and seek at most three later source observations 200 ms apart; changed coverage, regression, or failure to cover that cutoff is an error
eligibility.missingData: Explicit null, degraded status, or HTTP 503; never a fabricated zero
eligibility.marks: Positive finite native prices, one mark per market, age strictly below 60000 ms, no future block or timestamp; same-block log cutoffs require matching block hash and log index at or before the cutoff
eligibility.restContext: Sanitized public metadata observation only; composite REST state does not prove mark freshness or an exact log cutoff and never enters canonical accounting
eligibility.registry: Valid contract identities, scales at most 18, consistent exclusions, and maintenance fraction at least the initial fraction, both above 100 hundredths
eligibility.ranges: Block selectors must lie within processed coverage and the selected as-of cutoff
eligibility.canonicalMarketInputs: risk-hotpath-v3: latest MarkUpdated within the shared block/hash/log cutoff and full bounded FundingEventCompleted/scale-update observations inside indexed coverage; v2 never substitutes SDK/REST marks

protocolAnalytics.windows: 24h, 7d and 30d end at the selected block/log cutoff and start at the cutoff timestamp minus the duration (inclusive); 'coverage' spans all indexed events through the cutoff
protocolAnalytics.windowCompleteness: Complete when coverage begins at Exchange deployment or when the independently observed timestamp of the coverage start block is at or before the window start. Otherwise the window is incomplete and its totals are null; the first observed business event never proves completeness
protocolAnalytics.flows: Taker volume and trades from maker fills (counted once); fill fees from maker fills; protocol fees = insurance + protocol fees on open/increase/invert; liquidations and liquidation notional from PositionLiquidated; collateral deposits, withdrawals and net flow from account collateral events; active accounts traded or changed a position (deposits and account creation alone do not count)
protocolAnalytics.state: Open interest (long, short, total mark notional), isolated position collateral and skew = (long - short) / (long + short) at the cutoff. Requires deployment history; a bounded index reports state unavailable. A market without an eligible mark keeps collateral but nulls its open interest, skew and the protocol totals
protocolAnalytics.evidence: Each window retains its event count, first/last event ID and a hash of its ordered event IDs; live manifests add the coverage-window hash and the same-cutoff quarantine compares it
protocolAnalytics.liveReader: Optional bounded global reader: keyset pages every exact risk-hotpath-v3 event through the shared cutoff, re-verifies the last ingested event before each incremental read, rejects coverage start changes and regression, and commits nothing on failure. Raw global events are not mirrored into the compact serving database
protocolAnalytics.ratios: Truncated toward zero at six decimal places before display or comparison

riskSignals.principle: Signals compare facts already served at the same cutoff with published thresholds; they never create prices, PnL or funding. Each rule definition is hashed (ruleHash) and every signal retains its inputs and source event IDs
riskSignals.severity: critical > warning > watch; ranking is severity, then category (risk, activity, concentration, data-quality), then normalized threshold exceedance, then signal ID

rules.liquidation-distance: Side-adjusted (mark - funded liquidation price) / mark; watch <= 0.25, warning <= 0.15, critical <= 0.05; requires a proven funding checkpoint
rules.collateral-drawdown: -price PnL / isolated collateral; watch >= 0.25, warning >= 0.50, critical >= 0.75; funding excluded
rules.leverage-utilization: (mark notional / isolated collateral) / registry initial-margin leverage; watch >= 0.50, warning >= 0.80, critical >= 1.00; zero collateral is critical
rules.watchlist-crowding: Dominant-side share of snapshot mark notional with at least two accounts; watch >= 0.75, warning >= 0.90; evaluated only when protocol state is unavailable
rules.market-skew: |protocol open-interest skew|; watch >= 0.50, warning >= 0.75; requires deployment-history state
rules.liquidation-activity: Complete 24-hour liquidation notional / current market open interest; any liquidation is watch, warning >= 0.05, critical >= 0.20; count only when open interest is unavailable
rules.position-liquidated: Position closed by liquidation or deleveraging within 24 hours of the cutoff; warning
rules.risk-input-unavailable: Open position with a missing mark (warning) or unverified funding (watch, with an explicitly conditional zero-funding distance)

riskSignals.transitions: A live process carries firstObservedAsOfBlock and severitySinceAsOfBlock from its previous accepted snapshot and marks new, escalated, de-escalated or unchanged; without a previous snapshot every signal is a baseline. Resolved signals stay listed for 1000 blocks (at most 50)
riskSignals.stress: Shocks of -20%, -10%, -5%, +5%, +10% and +20% apply to every eligible as-of mark at once; equity = collateral + side-adjusted (shocked mark - effective entry) * size + proven unsettled funding; breach when equity <= entry-based maintenance. Unknown funding uses an explicit zero-funding conditional basis; positions without marks or with incomplete history are excluded and listed

comparison.scope: Wallets in the same snapshot and cutoff only; never a protocol-wide cohort
comparison.statistics: Open notional, open collateral, collateral leverage, realized PnL, unrealized price PnL, price return on open collateral and fees, from served wallet facts
comparison.percentiles: Midrank over replay-eligible wallets with a known value, truncated to two decimals; incomplete histories are excluded and listed
comparison.overlap: Pairwise open-market Jaccard index with same-side and opposing-side markets
comparison.labels: Nansen labels group participants for discovery and filtering, retain their own observation-time eligibility and never alter canonical numbers
